comment: MTG_BP_NEW_ONLY_DEMOTE (docs/design/bp-empty-arm-deferred-site.md; board from the 2026-10-14 Mirrorwing cast-order draft). Four lands pay exactly Gold Rush + Fists of Flame, and under Heroism the second trick carries one more payload: the cast order's Gold Rush -> Fists deals 46, Fists -> Gold Rush deals 50 (Fists 2..5 = 14, Gold Rush 2..10 = 30, base 6). The library is uncastable Dragons, so no card arrives at Fists' breakpoint and 'Gold Rush after Fists' is an old-cards-only continuation -- deleted by MTG_BP_NEW_ONLY as the sibling {Fists, Gold Rush}'s duplicate, although that sibling casts Gold Rush first. Unreachable at budget 0 before; found from the demoted wave. The fixture pins MTG_BP_NEW_ONLY_DEMOTE on (it ships OFF while the USER decides); at =0 the line is not found (opponent at 46).
